column1: Vagabonds and it’s hard to hear
With the line drawn from over there
To the middle of the road the first bars of night
With your heart of water and your face of stone
We won’t loiter we’ll soon be gone
To the center of the earth, to Orion’s belt
You go on - I’ll lag behind
While the saw blades turn and the waters dry
You light the torches, I’ll dream the dreams
Won't you help me dry out?
